description: Elasticsearch / OpenSearch config audit — Offline security audit of elasticsearch.yml or opensearch.yml (flat or nested YAML): authentication off (xpack.security.enabled false, or unset on 7.x; plugins.security.disabled), HTTP and transport TLS, verification_mode none, anonymous roles, network.host / http.host bound to 0.0.0.0 or public IPs, CORS allow-origin * (with credentials), legacy Groovy dynamic scripting (RCE), wildcard deletes, reindex remote allowlist *, plaintext passwords in the file (never echoed), OpenSearch demo certificates and demo security index, audit logging, duplicates. Returns PASS / REVIEW / FIX BEFORE DEPLOY / BLOCK, score, grade, product, exposure, findings with fixes and a hardened config. Params: text= or url=; optional version= (e.g. 7.17 or 8) for exact defaults. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description:
network.host: 0.0.0.0
xpack.security.enabled: false
http.cors.enabled: true
http.cors.allow-origin: "*"

name: security_elasticsearch_check
